entries.wants: the placeholder word for optional named options inside a usage line, lower case, as in 'hmz chat list [options]'
entries.where: usage line

entries.wants: what the --json option does: prints one JSON document instead of text
entries.where: option description in --help, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: print one JSON document instead of text

entries.wants: what the --daemon NAME option is: which daemon to ask, by the name it is kept under in the daemon list; this machine's daemon when not given
entries.where: option description in --help, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: ask the daemon named in the daemon list, or this machine's daemon

entries.wants: what the --no-color option does
entries.where: option description in --help, lower case start, no full stop

entries.wants: what -h/--help does
entries.where: option description in --help, lower case start, no full stop

entries.wants: meaning of exit status 0: the command did what was asked
entries.where: exit status meaning, lower case start, no full stop, a few words

entries.wants: meaning of exit status 1: the daemon refused the request and its reason was printed
entries.where: exit status meaning, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the daemon refused the request and its reason was printed

entries.wants: meaning of exit status 2: the command line could not be read (unknown option, missing argument)
entries.where: exit status meaning, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the command line could not be read

entries.wants: meaning of exit status 3: the daemon could not be reached
entries.where: exit status meaning, lower case start, no full stop
entries.text: the daemon could not be reached

entries.wants: note after an option's description giving its default; keep {value}
entries.where: bracketed note in --help, lower case, e.g. 'default: {value}'

entries.wants: note after an option's description saying the option may be given more than once
entries.where: bracketed note in --help, lower case, a few words
entries.text: may be given more than once

entries.wants: sentence introducing the list of fields of the JSON document a command prints with `--json`; ends with a colon; keep `--json` in backticks
entries.where: --help output section
entries.text: With `--json`, prints one object with these fields:

entries.wants: sentence telling the reader to run `{line}` to read everything about one subcommand; keep `{line}` in backticks
entries.where: end of a command group's --help
entries.text: Run `{line}` to read everything about one command.

entries.wants: sentence telling the reader to run `{line}` for help; keep `{line}` in backticks
entries.where: after a usage error

entries.wants: usage error: the word {name} is not the name of any command here
entries.where: error line after 'hmz chat: ', lower case start, no full stop

entries.wants: usage error: a subcommand name is required after a command group
entries.where: error line after 'hmz chat: ', lower case start, no full stop

entries.wants: error: no daemon is kept under the name {name}
entries.where: error sentence with full stop
entries.text: No daemon is kept under the name {name}.

entries.wants: error: the daemon cannot be reached: {why}
entries.where: error line, lower case start, no full stop
